crossRefs.note: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
“Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
“Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many…
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

translations.web: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.
translations.bsb: Though they hide themselves atop Carmel, there I will track them and seize them; and though they hide from Me at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
translations.kjv: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite
translations.asv: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and it shall bite them.
